section.content: The inventor provides a lithium ion battery, which comprises a shell, a battery core and a top cover, wherein the upper end surface of a top cover main body is covered with a layer of self-cleaning coating. The lithium ion battery can effectively reduce the surface energy of the battery top cover, avoid the corrosion of the battery top cover by electrolyte or the secondary pollution caused by the electrolyte entering the battery, and improve the safety of the production and the use of the battery because the upper end surface is covered with the self-cleaning coating.
发明人提供了一种锂离子电池，包括外壳、电芯和顶盖，所述顶盖主体的上端面覆盖一层自清洁涂层。本发明的锂离子电池，由于在上端面覆盖了自清洁涂层，能有效降低电池顶盖的表面能，避免电解液对电池顶盖腐蚀或进入电池内部造成二次污染，提高电池生产和使用的安全性。

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The invention relates to the field of batteries, in particular to a lithium ion battery.

Background

With the development of society, new energy automobiles are continuously popularized and developed, the core-battery of the new energy automobiles is continuously upgraded, and the energy density is continuously improved. The development is 26650 from 18650, and finally the development is directed to a square-shell battery with larger volume.

Currently, due to the increasing demand for energy density of batteries, the active materials of square-shell batteries are gradually transitioning from the current lithium iron phosphate (LFP) to Nickel Cobalt Manganese (NCM) ternary materials. However, due to the particularity of the novel ternary material, the requirement of the novel ternary material on the electrolyte is different from that of the electrolyte required in the traditional lithium iron phosphate core. The electrolyte of the nickel-cobalt-manganese ternary material contains lithium hexafluorophosphate, various solvents and additives, and has strong corrosivity while improving the energy and the cycle performance of the battery. Leakage during battery liquid injection in the battery manufacturing process and overflow of electrolyte during battery negative pressure formation can cause corrosion of the battery top cover to different degrees. The electrolyte can corrode the battery explosion-proof valve, so that the pressure bearing capacity of the explosion-proof valve cannot meet the design standard, and the safety accident of a battery core is caused; meanwhile, the electrolyte also corrodes the two-dimensional code of the battery top cover, so that the battery top cover is difficult to recognize and the manufacturing source of the battery cannot be traced.

Disclosure of Invention

In view of the problems in the prior art, an object of the present invention is to provide a lithium ion battery capable of effectively preventing corrosion of an electrolyte, and preventing corrosion of the electrolyte to a battery top cap and corrosion of the electrolyte to an explosion-proof valve of the battery, thereby improving the safety and long-term performance of the battery.

In order to achieve the purpose, the invention provides a lithium ion battery which comprises a shell, a battery core and a top cover, wherein the upper end surface of the top cover is covered with a layer of self-cleaning coating.

Compared with the prior art, the invention at least comprises the following beneficial effects: according to the lithium ion battery provided by the invention, the self-cleaning coating of the top cover can reduce the surface energy of the top cover of the battery, so that the surface of the coating has a self-cleaning function. The coating can firstly generate the physical blocking effect on the electrolyte and the top cover, so that the battery top cover can not be in direct contact with the electrolyte, and then the surface of the self-cleaning coating of the top cover is lower than the surface roughness of the top cover, so that the retention time and the residual amount of the electrolyte can be reduced to a certain extent, the corrosion of the electrolyte on the top cover of the battery or the secondary pollution caused by the electrolyte entering the battery can be effectively avoided, and the use safety and the long-term performance of the lithium ion battery are improved.

Drawings

Fig. 1 is a schematic structural diagram of a top cover of a lithium ion battery according to an embodiment of the present invention, wherein a gray shaded portion is a self-cleaning coating of the top cover of the lithium ion battery.

Description of reference numerals:

1. a positive pole is arranged on the anode column,

2. a liquid injection hole is arranged on the bottom of the liquid storage tank,

3. an anti-explosion valve is arranged on the valve body,

4. the identification code is a code that is unique to the user,

5. and a negative pole.

Detailed Description

The lithium ion battery according to the present invention is explained in detail below.

The invention provides a lithium ion battery which comprises a shell, a battery cell and a top cover, wherein the upper end surface of a top cover main body is covered with a layer of self-cleaning coating.

In the lithium ion battery, the components of the electrolyte are complex and are mostly the combination of an organic solvent and various addition salts, so that in the process of manufacturing the battery, leakage during battery liquid injection and overflow of the electrolyte during negative pressure formation of the battery can cause corrosion of the top cover of the battery to different degrees. Electrolyte can cause the corruption to battery explosion-proof valve, makes explosion-proof valve's bearing capacity can not reach the emergence that design standard leads to electric core incident the up end of top cap main part covers the corruption that one deck automatically cleaning coating can reduce electrolyte to the top cap effectively, has avoided remaining inside electrolyte gets into the battery from the hole of top cap, causes secondary pollution to the battery, has increased the protection to battery explosion-proof valve simultaneously, has improved the security of battery.

The self-cleaning coating covers the top cover, the surface roughness of the self-cleaning coating influences the corrosion speed of the electrolyte, the time for the electrolyte to stay on the self-cleaning coating is mainly determined by the surface roughness of the self-cleaning coating, the smaller the surface roughness of the self-cleaning coating is, the larger the contact angle between the electrolyte and the self-cleaning coating is, the shorter the time for the electrolyte to stay on the self-cleaning coating is, and the smaller the corrosion of the electrolyte to the self-cleaning coating and the top cover is, so that the surface roughness of the self-cleaning coating is selected in a proper range, and the cleaning capacity of the self-cleaning coating can be better improved.

Preferably, the surface roughness of the self-cleaning coating is between 0.012 μm and 12.5 μm, further preferably the surface roughness of the self-cleaning coating is between 0.012 μm and 6.3 μm.

The thickness of automatically cleaning coating influences the corruption of electrolyte to the top cap, and the thicker automatically cleaning coating is, and electrolyte is difficult more to corrode the top cap, but the thickening of automatically cleaning coating can cause the decline of the luminousness of automatically cleaning coating, deserves to explain, for the convenience of pursuit lithium ion battery's source, can set up the identification code at lithium ion battery top cap usually, for guaranteeing the completeness of identification code, automatically cleaning coating cover in the identification code, for the identification code of being convenient for discernment, the luminousness of automatically cleaning coating need keep in suitable within range, consequently, need right the suitable scope is selected to the thickness of automatically cleaning coating.

Preferably, the thickness of the self-cleaning coating is 20-100nm, further preferably, the thickness of the self-cleaning coating is 30-50 nm.

Preferably, the self-cleaning coating has a light transmittance of 40% or more.

The self-cleaning coating comprises fluorine-containing silane, different fluorine-containing silanes influence the time of electrolyte staying on the surface of the coating, and the larger the molecular weight of the fluorine-containing silane is, the longer the molecular chain of the fluorine-containing silane is, the larger the contact angle of the electrolyte is, and the easier the sliding is. The less the time of the electrolyte staying on the surface of the self-cleaning coating, the lower the residual content of the electrolyte on the surface of the self-cleaning coating, the less the corrosion, and the different fluorine-containing silanes have different corrosion resistance to the electrolyte. The fluorine-containing silane contains fluorine and silicon elements, so that the self-cleaning coating has high strength and strong durability, can be kept all the time under the condition of no mechanical hanging and rubbing, and has good protection effect on the coating surface.

Preferably, the self-cleaning coating comprises:

fluorine-containing silane with the structural formula shown as formula (I)

Wherein R is1Selected from fluoro or fluoro substituted branched alkanes of C1-C10, R2Selected from fluoro, chloro or alkoxy of C1-C10.

Preferably, the fluorine-containing silane is selected from one or more of perfluorooctyltrimethoxysilane, 1H,2H, 2H-perfluorodecyltrichlorosilane and 1H,1H,2H, 2H-perfluorodecyltriethoxysilane.

Fluorine-containing silane needs to be dispersed in a certain solvent, so that the preparation of the self-cleaning coating is convenient, the fluorine-containing silane is dissolved in an organic solvent to form a silica three-dimensional network structure more easily, and after the solution is mixed and coated, because the solvent has the characteristics of being volatile and not reacting with a solute, the solvent is quickly volatilized, and simultaneously the residual fluorine-containing silane quickly forms a molecular film consisting of a lower silica network structure and an upper fluorocarbon branched chain on the surface of the top cover, so that the direct contact between electrolyte and the top cover is prevented. And the carbon-fluorine bond reduces the contact angle between the electrolyte and the top cover, so that the electrolyte is not easy to be polluted and remained.

Preferably, the self-cleaning coating further comprises an organic solvent, and the organic solvent is one or more selected from anhydrous ethanol, acetone and diethyl ether.

Preferably, be provided with anodal post and negative pole post on the top cap main part, be provided with between anodal post and the negative pole post and annotate liquid hole, explosion-proof valve and identification code.

Preferably, the self-cleaning coating covers the region of the top cover except for the positive and negative electrode posts.

The self-cleaning coating covers the top cover surface completely, and can effectively protect the battery top cover and the identification code.

Preferably, said self-cleaning coating covers said identification code.

The integrity of the identification code is convenient for tracing the source of the lithium ion battery in the later period, therefore, the self-cleaning coating covers the identification code, the integrity of the identification code can be effectively ensured, and the tracing of the source of the lithium ion battery is convenient.

In order to explain technical contents, structural features, and objects and effects of the technical means in detail, the following detailed description is given with reference to specific embodiments. It should be understood that these examples are for illustrative purposes only and are not intended to limit the scope of the present application.

The surface self-cleaning layers of examples 1-16 were prepared as follows, and comparative example 1 was a blank control.

Preparing a surface self-cleaning layer:

first, 1ml of fluorosilane was drip-added to 100ml of the solvent according to Table 1, and mixed uniformly with a glass rod. Finally, the prepared solution is dipped by a fine hair brush, evenly coated on the upper end face of the top cover and kept stand for one hour. And then, qualitatively polishing the coating area of the top cover by using sand paper with different meshes to manufacture the top covers with different roughness, and repeating the coating process after drying to obtain the top covers with different coating film thicknesses and different surface roughness. The parameters of the cap are shown in table 1.

The following describes the performance test method of the self-cleaning coating:

1) test method of initial corrosion time:

the electrolyte was dropped perpendicular to the top cap by drip irrigation onto the top caps of the above preparation examples 1 to 16 and comparative example 1, 5 drops per top cap and left to stand. The corrosion was judged by observing the white corrosion (color shade, area size) on the top cap surface at different times and the time at which white corrosion began to appear is reported in table 1.

It is worth noting that the time to start corrosion needs to be well defined; and (3) allowing the electrolyte drops to stand on the top covers with different coatings and thicknesses, observing the liquid and the contact surface by using a CCD (charge coupled device) amplification camera every 1 hour, gradually whitening the surface of the top cover corroded by the electrolyte on the contact surface along with the increase of time, and generating white powder, wherein the corrosion time is the beginning time.

2) The surface roughness test method of the surface self-cleaning layer comprises the following steps: the surface roughness measuring instrument is used, a diamond contact pin with the tip curvature radius of about 2 micrometers slides slowly along the measured surface, the up-down displacement of the diamond contact pin is converted into an electric signal by an electric length sensor, the surface roughness value is indicated by a display instrument after amplification, filtering and calculation, and the instrument is used for automatically calculating the arithmetic mean deviation R alpha of the profile, the height RZ of the microscopic unevenness ten points, the maximum height Ry of the profile and other various evaluation parameters.

3) Testing the thickness of the surface self-cleaning layer: and (4) making a top cover cross section, observing a fault under a high-power microscope scanning tunnel microscope, and measuring the thickness of the coating by using computer self-contained measuring software.

4) Testing the light transmittance of the surface self-cleaning layer: and (3) testing by using a split type light transmittance tester DRTG-81, and coating a fluorine-containing silane solution on a transparent glass slide with the thickness of 0.5mm according to a top cover coating mode and coating times. The transmittance of the slides was measured before coating and was calibrated to 100% transmittance. And then, the glass slides with different coatings are measured, and the measured values obtained by the tester are the light transmittances of the different coatings.

5) Testing the contact angle of the surface self-cleaning layer: the electrolyte drops were measured on the coated caps using a static contact angle measuring instrument SZ-CAMA 1.

The parameters and performance test results for the lithium ion battery top cover provided in examples 1-16 and comparative example 1 are shown in table 1 below:

table 1 lithium ion battery top cover parameters and technical effects of examples 1-16 and comparative example 1

As can be seen from table 1, in examples 1 to 16, compared with comparative example 1, the contact angle between the lithium ion battery top cover containing the surface self-cleaning coating and the electrolyte is larger than that between the lithium ion battery top cover without the surface self-cleaning coating and the electrolyte in comparative example 1, and the corrosion start time of the surface in examples 1 to 16 is much longer than that in comparative example 1, which indicates that the self-cleaning coating of the top cover can effectively increase the contact angle between the top cover and the electrolyte, and reduce the retention time and residual amount of the electrolyte on the top cover, thereby effectively reducing the corrosion of the electrolyte on the top cover, and improving the safety and long-term performance of the lithium ion battery.

Further, it can be seen from examples 1-5 that the surface roughness of the self-cleaning coating affects the corrosion protection properties of the lithium ion battery top cover. Because the surface roughness affects the contact angle of the self-cleaning layer and the electrolyte, the smaller the surface roughness, the smoother the surface of the top cover, the smaller the contact angle of the electrolyte on the surface, the easier the electrolyte slides off the top cover, and the less electrolyte is remained on the top cover, thereby reducing the corrosion of the electrolyte on the top cover.

Further, it can be seen from examples 6-9 that the thickness of the self-cleaning coating affects the corrosion protection properties of the lithium ion battery top cover. The thicker the self-cleaning coating thickness, the obviously increased the number of the micro molecular functional groups on the surface of the self-cleaning coating, thereby increasing the contact angle of the self-cleaning coating to a certain extent, the larger the contact angle of the electrolyte, the shorter the time of electrolyte remaining on the top cover, thereby reducing the corrosion of the electrolyte to the top cover, meanwhile, the contact between the electrolyte and the top cover can be effectively isolated by the increase of the coating thickness, the larger the self-cleaning coating thickness, the more difficult the self-cleaning coating is corroded by the electrolyte, and the longer the protection time of the top cover is. However, too large a thickness affects light transmittance, and thus the thickness of the self-cleaning layer needs to be controlled within a suitable range.

Further, as can be seen from examples 10 to 13, the number of carbon atoms of R1 and R2 of the fluorine-containing silane affects the corrosion preventing performance of the lithium ion battery top cover. The larger the molecular weight of the fluorine-containing silane, that is, the larger the number of carbon atoms of R1 and R2, the larger the contact angle of the electrolytic solution, and the more easily the sliding. The less electrolyte remains on the top cover and the less corrosion will be caused to the top cover surface.

Further, as can be seen from examples 14 to 16, the organic solvent used in the preparation may affect the corrosion prevention performance of the lithium ion battery top cover to some extent. Different solvents have different volatilization rates in air, a part of organic solvent is remained in the self-cleaning coating, and the organic solvent and the fluorine-containing silane are combined with each other to form the self-cleaning coating, so that the part of the solvent does not influence the contact angle between the electrolyte and the self-cleaning coating, but has certain influence on the corrosion time of the final electrolyte as a part of the self-cleaning coating.
